#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits.h>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, next, weight, capacity, flow, cost;
};

struct Pair {
    long first, second;
    Pair(long first, long second) : first(first), second(second) {}
};

struct Heap {
    vector<int> elements;
    int size;
    Heap(int maxElement) {
        elements.resize(maxElement);
        size = 0;
    }
    void add(int element) {
        elements[size] = element;
        size++;
        shiftUp(size - 1);
    }
    void shiftUp(int index) {
        while (index != 0) {
            int parent = (index - 1) / 2;
            if (elements[parent] <= elements[index]) {
                break;
            }
            swap(elements[parent], elements[index]);
            index = parent;
        }
    }
    int poll() {
        if (size == 0) {
            return -1;
        }
        int result = elements[0];
        elements[0] = elements[size - 1];
        size--;
        shiftDown(0);
        return result;
    }
    void shiftDown(int index) {
        while (true) {
            int child = 2 * index + 1;
            if (child >= size) {
                break;
            }
            if (child + 1 < size && elements[child] > elements[child + 1]) {
                child++;
            }
            if (elements[index] <= elements[child]) {
                break;
            }
            swap(elements[index], elements[child]);
            index = child;
        }
    }
};

class Graph {
public:
    int vertexCount, edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound, firstInbound;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> nextInbound, nextOutbound;
    vector<int> from, to;
    vector<long> weight, capacity, flow;
    vector<int> reverseEdge, flags;
    Graph(int vertexCount) {
        this->vertexCount = vertexCount;
        firstOutbound.resize(vertexCount);
        firstInbound.resize(vertexCount);
        edges.resize(vertexCount);
        nextInbound.resize(vertexCount);
        nextOutbound.resize(vertexCount);
        from.resize(vertexCount);
        to.resize(vertexCount);
        weight.resize(vertexCount);
        capacity.resize(vertexCount);
        flow.resize(vertexCount);
        reverseEdge.resize(vertexCount);
        flags.resize(vertexCount);
    }
    void addEdge(int fromID, int toID, long weight, long capacity, int reverseEdge) {
        int edgeID = edgeCount++;
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[edgeID] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[edgeID] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeID;
        if (firstInbound[toID] != -1) {
            nextInbound[edgeID] = firstInbound[toID];
        } else {
            nextInbound[edgeID] = -1;
        }
        firstInbound[toID] = edgeID;
        this->from[edgeID] = fromID;
        this->to[edgeID] = toID;
        if (capacity != 0) {
            this->capacity[edgeID] = capacity;
        }
        if (weight != 0) {
            this->weight[edgeID] = weight;
        }
        if (reverseEdge != -1) {
            this->reverseEdge[edgeID] = reverseEdge;
        }
        edges[edgeID].to = toID;
        edges[edgeID].next = nextOutbound[edgeID];
        edges[edgeID].weight = weight;
        edges[edgeID].capacity = capacity;
        edges[edgeID].flow = 0;
        edges[edgeID].cost = 0;
    }
    void addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, long weight, long capacity) {
        int edgeID = edgeCount++;
        addEdge(to, from, -weight, 0, edgeID);
        addEdge(from, to, weight, capacity, edgeID);
    }
    int vertexCount() {
        return vertexCount;
    }
    int firstOutbound(int vertex) {
        int id = firstOutbound[vertex];
        while (id != -1 && flags[id] == 1) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }
    int nextOutbound(int id) {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && flags[id] == 1) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }
    int source(int id) {
        return from[id];
    }
    int destination(int id) {
        return to[id];
    }
    long weight(int id) {
        return weight[id];
    }
    long capacity(int id) {
        return capacity[id];
    }
    long flow(int id) {
        return flow[reverseEdge[id]];
    }
    void pushFlow(int id, long flow) {
        if (flow == 0) {
            return;
        }
        if (flow > 0) {
            if (capacity(id) < flow) {
                throw -1;
            }
        } else {
            if (flow(id) < -flow) {
                throw -1;
            }
        }
        capacity(id) -= flow;
        flow[reverseEdge[id]] += flow;
    }
    bool flag(int id, int bit) {
        return (flags[id] >> bit & 1) != 0;
    }
    bool isRemoved(int id) {
        return flag(id, 0);
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    Graph graph;
    int source, destination;
    long phi[vertexCount];
    long dijkstraResult[vertexCount];
    int lastEdge[vertexCount];
    Heap heap;
    int vertexCount;
    int visitIndex;
    MinCostFlow(Graph graph, int source, int destination) {
        this->graph = graph;
        this->source = source;
        this->destination = destination;
        vertexCount = graph.vertexCount();
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            phi[i] = LONG_MAX;
        }
        phi[source] = 0;
        heap = Heap(vertexCount);
        visitIndex = 0;
    }
    void fordBellman() {
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            phi[i] = LONG_MAX;
        }
        phi[source] = 0;
        bool* inQueue = new bool[vertexCount];
        int* queue = new int[vertexCount + 1];
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int stepCount = 0;
        int head = 0;
        int end = 1;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == queue[0] + 1) {
                head = 0;
            }
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0 && phi[graph.destination(edgeID)] > phi[vertex] + graph.weight(edgeID)) {
                    phi[graph.destination(edgeID)] = phi[vertex] + graph.weight(edgeID);
                    if (!inQueue[graph.destination(edgeID)]) {
                        queue[end++] = graph.destination(edgeID);
                        inQueue[graph.destination(edgeID)] = true;
                        if (end == queue[0] + 1) {
                            end = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw -1;
            }
        }
    }
    Pair<long, long> minCostMaxFlow(long maxFlow) {
        long cost = 0;
        long flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return Pair<long, long>(cost, flow);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            long currentFlow = maxFlow;
            long currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacity(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weight(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        return Pair<long, long>(cost, flow);
    }
    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            dijkstraResult[i] = LONG_MAX;
            lastEdge[i] = -1;
        }
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        heap.add(source);
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            int current = heap.poll();
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    long total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        if (heap.getIndex(next) == -1) {
                            heap.add(next);
                        } else {
                            heap.shiftUp(heap.getIndex(next));
                        }
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        visitIndex++;
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            dijkstraResult[i] = LONG_MAX;
            lastEdge[i] = -1;
        }
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            int index = -1;
            long length = LONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < vertexCount; j++) {
                if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < length) {
                    length = dijkstraResult[j];
                    index = j;
                }
            }
            if (index == -1) {
                return;
            }
            visited[index] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(index);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (visited[next] != visitIndex) {
                        long total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[index] + length;
                        if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                            lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int ugliness[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> ugliness[i];
    }
    Graph graph(1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1);
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            int cost = 0;
            if (c == s[i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
            }
            if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
            }
            graph.addEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1, -1);
        }
    }
    int occurs[128];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        occurs[s[i]]++;
    }
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
        graph.addEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), 0, occurs[c], -1);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        graph.addEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 0, 2, -1);
    }
    MinCostFlow minCostFlow(graph, 0, 1 + 26 + n / 2);
    Pair<long, long> flow = minCostFlow.minCostMaxFlow(n);
    cout << -flow.first << endl;
    return 0;
}
